description: Typed eligibility result for one posting: dashboard classification, decision + relevance evidence, explicit unknown flags, pay comparison vs Kyle's current $21/hour, and source/apply-link provenance. Synthetic data only.

classification.description: Dashboard classification. The contract never emits Stretch; it is reserved for the ranking layer (CN-005).

decision_status.description: Core decision: eligible maps to Strong Fit/Realistic, review to Needs Review, rejected to Excluded.

confidence.description: Uncertain matches stay visible; nothing is silently merged.

annual_high.description: Annualized high pay (unrounded), or null when unknown.

annual_low.description: Annualized guaranteed-low pay (unrounded), or null when unknown.

current_annual.description: Kyle's current $21/hour annualized on policy hours/weeks ($43,680 at 40h x 52w).

delta_annual.description: annual_low minus current_annual, or null when the low is unknown.

meets_floor.description: True when the core pay reason passes the $19/hr floor, false when it excludes for wholly-below-floor pay, null when unknown (missing, unparseable, straddle, or open-ended low below the floor).

raw.description: Pay text as stated in the posting.

vs_current.description: Guaranteed-low pay vs Kyle's current $21/hour (annualized on policy hours/weeks).

reasons.description: One reason per core factor (employer, role, driving, location, pay).

priority.description: Priority band for eligible results; null for review/rejected.

value.description: Job relevance index 0-100 (posting-side evidence only; not verified candidate fit).

wording.description: Fixed disclaimer wording for the relevance index.

original_url.description: URL as supplied, retained as provenance.

rewritten.description: True when the canonical URL differs from the original.

driving.description: True when the posting never mentions driving/licensing (unknown, not verified no-driving).

list.description: Names of the unknown flags that are set, in flag order.

location_missing.description: True when the posting states no location.

pay.description: True when pay is missing or unparseable; value remains unknown, never coerced.

remote_pa.description: True when a remote posting's Pennsylvania eligibility could not be established (unstated, conditional, or conflicting evidence).

upstream_records.description: Upstream verdict/status carried as source records only (not truth).

title: Career Navigator result contract
